## Listbox.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `options` :: Listbox choices, optionally grouped by `group`.
- `value` :: Selected value (single) or values (`multiple`); bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called when selection changes.
- `multiple` :: Allow selecting multiple options.
- `size` :: Option row height and text scale on the shared size ladder.
- `shape` :: Outer container corner shape.
- `maxHeight` :: Vertical scroll cap using a `Size` step (`h-xl`) or CSS length.
- `disabled` :: Disables all interaction.
- `emptyText` :: Message shown when `options` is empty.
- `label` :: Accessible label naming the list.
- `surface` :: The recipe behind the list panel: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'elevated'
- `pad` :: The inset inside the panel. @default 'pad-xs'
- `gap` :: The space between rows. @default 'gap-xs'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of group headings, descriptions and the empty message. @default 'text-xs'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of group headings, descriptions, icons and the empty message. @default 'text-muted'

## listbox.ts

### `interface ListboxOption`

One choice in a Listbox. `value` is what it reports; the rest is presentation.

- `group` :: Section the option belongs to; options are grouped in first-seen order.

### `interface ListboxSection`

One section of options, in the order its first member appeared.

### `function groupOptions`

Bucket options by `group`, keeping the order in which each group first appears.
